Scene plate (top-down highway + interceptor), speckle/grain and the model-painted contour accepted; road texture is art-13..18's deliverable, and the anchor is a style reference, not a sprite source. Reviewer had failed it on palette 2 / consistency 2 / background 1.

Residuals carried by WO-22: 128px sprite drawn unscaled in game, damaged/wrecked frame names swapped, tail bar quantises to signal-red.
